camel_example: aliyun dbfs CreateDbfs --region cn-hangzhou --Category standard --FsName 'testdbfs-001' --ZoneId 'cn-hangzhou-i' --SizeG 200 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --version 2020-04-18 --method POST --force
description_en: Creates a pay-as-you-go Database File System
description_zh: 调用CreateDbfs创建一个按量付费的数据库文件系统
kebab_example: aliyun dbfs create-dbfs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --fs-name testdbfs-001 --category standard --size-g 200 --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDbfs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DBFS instance. You can call the DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html) operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: DBFS实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html)查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Database File System.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length, and must start with an English letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
数据库文件系统名称。

取值范围：2~128个字符，以英文大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线和连字符（-）
parameters.name: fs_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Database File System. Valid values:
standard: Standard Edition
enterprise: Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
数据库文件系统类型。取值范围：
standard：标准版
enterprise：企业版
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en:
The capacity of the Database File System. Unit: GiB. If you specify this parameter, the value must be greater than or equal to the size of the specified snapshot.

Valid values:
If RAID 0 striping is disabled: an integer from 20 to 32,768.
If RAID 0 striping is enabled: an integer from 160 to 262,144
parameters.help_zh:
容量大小，以GiB为单位。指定该参数后，其取值必须≥指定快照ID的容量大小。

取值范围：不使能RAID0条带化时为20-32768之间的整数；使能RAID0条带化时为160-262144之间的整数
parameters.name: size_g

parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the DBFS instance
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must ensure that it is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多详情，请参见如何保证幂等性 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html)
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the snapshot that is used to create the DBFS instance
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to delete the original snapshot after the DBFS is created from the snapshot
parameters.help_zh: 使用快照创建DBFS后是否删除原始快照
parameters.name: delete_snapshot

parameters.help_en:
The performance level of the DBFS instance. Valid values:

PL0: A single disk can deliver up to 10,000 random read/write IOPS.

PL1: A single disk can deliver up to 50,000 random read/write IOPS. This is the default value.

PL2: A single disk can deliver up to 100,000 random read/write IOPS.

PL3: A single disk can deliver up to 1,000,000 random read/write IOPS
parameters.help_zh:
创建DBFS实例时，设置DBFS的性能等级。取值范围：

PL0：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 1万

PL1：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 5万（默认值）

PL2：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 10万

PL3：单盘最高随机读写IOPS 100万
parameters.name: performance_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to create the DBFS in RAID mode.

Valid values:
true: Creates the DBFS in RAID mode.
false: Does not create the DBFS in RAID mode.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否以RAID方式来创建DBFS。

取值范围：true或false，默认值为false
parameters.name: enable_raid

parameters.help_en:
The number of stripes. This parameter is required when the EnableRaid parameter is set to true.

Valid values: an integer from 2 to 8
parameters.help_zh:
条带数量。当EnableRaid参数为true时必传。

取值范围：2-8之间的整数
parameters.name: raid_stripe_unit_number

parameters.help_en: The ID of the KMS key used by the DBFS
parameters.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to encrypt the DBFS.

Valid values:
true: Encrypts the DBFS.
false: Does not encrypt the DBFS.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否加密DBFS。

取值范围：true或false，默认值为false
parameters.name: encryption

parameters.help_en:
The scenarios of the DBFS. Valid values:

MySQL 5.7

PostgreSQL

MongoDB

Oracle RAC
parameters.help_zh:
DBFS的使用场景。取值范围：

MySQL 5.7

PostgreSQL

MongoDB

Oracle RAC
parameters.name: used_scene

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

dbfs.small

dbfs.medium

dbfs.large (default)
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。取值范围：

dbfs.small

dbfs.medium

dbfs.large（默认值）
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The advanced features that allow you to customize the number of CPU cores and the maximum memory size for the Database File System instance.

cpuCoreCount: The number of CPU cores.
memorySize: The memory size. Unit: MB.
pageCacheSize: The page cache size. Unit: MB
parameters.help_zh:
可定制数据库文件存储实例使用的CPU核数、内存上限值等。

cpuCoreCount：CPU核数。
memorySize：内存大小，单位MB。
pageCacheSize：PageCache缓存大小，单位MB
parameters.name: advanced_features
